title: System Demo: Tool and Infrastructure for Offensive Language Error Analysis (OLEA) in English
measurement_description: The paper evaluated the performance of offensive language detection models (using accuracy, F1 score, precision, and recall) in correctly classifying hate speech directed at specific targeted identity groups, including Muslims.
findings: When evaluated on the HateCheck dataset, the models did a better job of recognizing hateful speech when a specific identity was targeted compared to when one was not. Specifically, the roBERTa-offensive model achieved an accuracy of 63.2% on hate speech instances targeting Muslims.
